text: Debugging is an important skill for any programmer. When your code does not work as expected, the first step is identifying bugs. You need to find where the problem is and understand why it happens. Many developers use debugging tools, such as breakpoints and step-by-step execution, to examine their code closely. A systematic approach is also helpful: check one part at a time instead of guessing randomly. Another useful method is logging, which means adding print statements to see what your program is doing. By combining these strategies, you can solve problems faster and become a more confident programmer.
